data.summary: The figures I checked match NVIDIA's reported fiscal 2025 results: revenue of $130.5B (vs. $60.9B in FY2024), net income of $72.9B, operating income of $81.5B, total assets of $111.6B and cash and cash equivalents of about $8.6B. As your note asked, I didn't check the revenue growth percentage because it was already verified.
